products.title: Honey Oak Herringbone Luxury Click Vinyl Flooring 6.5mm
products.body_html:
Luxury Click Vinyl Flooring · 6.5mm · Painted Bevel Edges

Bring timeless parquet-inspired style to your home with Honey Oak Herringbone Luxury Click Vinyl Flooring. Its warm honey oak tones and distinctive herringbone pattern create an inviting foundation for both classic and contemporary interiors.

The painted bevel edges define each individual plank, giving the pattern greater depth and a beautifully tailored finish. With a 6.5mm overall thickness, Honey Oak brings together considered detailing and the everyday practicality of luxury click vinyl.
